title: Cute buff
description: This project adds cool things, for small perfomance impact!
body:
# What it adds?

This modpack adds cool things to Minecraft, like colorful lights,  dynamic lights. For low performance impact!

_Works on phones as well! (On Minecraft Java Edition.)_

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/LaPsPjhl5RY" title="Odtwarzacz filmów na YouTube" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## What features have this modpack?

It has super optymalization mods like sodium, sodium extra, or BBE (Better Block Entities), and more!

Optimalization mods have one goal, to optimalize Minecraft that much, to allow me to add some cool mods, like **Shine**, and others!

## Why do you would to install it?

This modpack is optimalized, stable, easy to configure, and supports new versions of the game!

## If you have less then 50FPS.

I recommend switching resorce pack from Whimscape to barebones.

**Whimscape -> Bare bones**

_You must place Bare bones in the same position as Whimscape beforce!_

## What if you don't have bare bones?

Sadly, there's no Bare bones for Minecraft 26.1 +, and you must use default vanilla textures.

# Warn to V2!
If you install replay mod, disable bookshelf inspector or uninstall it! Otherwise game can crash!
